2610.10092.title: I would rather quit NLP than read another paper like this: The rise of antithesis in NLP papers
2610.10092.paper_summary: For better or worse, LLMs are by now used routinely for scientific writing.\footnote{This paper is no exception; we did use AI to assist with writing some of the sections (see Acknowledgments).} Many have noticed that recent models fill papers with unnecessary antithesis, stating over and over what the work does not do, in ways that do not contribute to its precision or quality of expression and annoy reviewers \emph{rather than impressing them}. We study the construction \emph{rather than} in ACL papers from 2019, ACL-style arXiv papers from 2026, and papers written by GPT models from the same titles and abstracts. Its rate in 2026 is seven times the 2019 rate, and higher still in the GPT papers. Two annotators, blind to the source, find almost no 2019 use \emph{annoying} and about one in ten 2026 uses; they seldom agree on which, yet about half of 2026 papers contain a use that annoys each of them. \emph{Annoying} uses present the rejected alternative less favorably than legitimate uses. Raters of preference data and open reward models favor the construction, and an instruction to be honest promotes it. We conjecture that it is a side effect of post-training on pairwise preferences, which credit a disavowal in a single response and cannot register its cost across a text.
2610.10092.paper_summary_zh: 對於好壞皆然，LLMs 現在已經被常規用於科學寫作。\footnote{這篇論文也不例外；我們確實使用 AI 協助撰寫某些部分（見致謝）。} 許多人注意到，最近的模型在論文中填充了不必要的對立，反覆陳述這項工作不做什麼，這種方式並未對其精確性或表達質量有所貢獻，反而讓審稿人感到\emph{煩擾而非印象深刻}。我們研究了 2019 年 ACL 論文、2026 年 ACL 風格的 arXiv 論文，以及由 GPT 模型撰寫的相同標題和摘要的論文中的\emph{而非}結構。2026 年的使用率是 2019 年的七倍，而在 GPT 論文中更高。兩位標註者對來源不知情，幾乎找不到 2019 年的\emph{煩擾}用法，約有十分之一的 2026 年用法讓他們感到煩擾；他們對哪一個用法的看法很少一致，但約有一半的 2026 年論文包含了讓他們各自感到煩擾的用法。\emph{煩擾}的用法比合法用法更不利地呈現被拒絕的替代方案。偏好數據和開放獎勵模型的評分者偏好這種結構，而誠實的指示則促進了它。我們推測這是後訓練在成對偏好上的副作用，這種偏好在單一回應中給予否認的認可，卻無法在文本中註冊其成本。
